proposed_evidence_path: Future worker creates a new fresh Row23 run folder under frdp-p01-codex-semantic-quality-heldout.

Future worker creates or receives row23-eval-only-input.jsonl inside that folder only. A deterministic local fixture may be constructed only as runner-contract/readback smoke evidence; it is not eval generation, is not a heldout/eval dataset, cannot support semantic-quality claims, and must be tagged synthetic_fixture_only=true with actual_approved_eval_executed=false.

If input is a deterministic local fixture, the result may prove only fixture-level runner contract/readback behavior and claim locks, not product semantic quality improvement, heldout pass, or any real eval result.

If input is intended to support semantic quality, it must be pre-existing or separately approved heldout input and must come with accepted same-scenario Row23 Codex baseline/adaptive behavior evidence, source-disjoint heldout controls, leakage controls, and reviewer notes.
Future worker may run only the existing eval-only runner with --output-dir constrained to the fresh Row23 folder.
Future worker captures stdout/stderr, exit code, output file list, hashes/readback, and packet MD/JSON in the same fresh folder.
Future worker preserves all result layers as not_proven unless independently reviewed same-scenario before/after Row23 Codex behavior evidence and host-visible evidence exist.
